sources.title: Reconcile bank accounts (en-US)
sources.appliesTo: Business Central cash-management documentation, en-US; checked 2026-09-26
fields: Separate bank account reconciliation matches statement lines to internal bank account ledger entries; distinct from payment reconciliation journal
Import bank statement lines or suggest lines; automatic text matching supports a date tolerance and can be reviewed or replaced with manual matches
Use Test Report and resolve Difference values before posting; matched lines with differences can't be posted, while valid unmatched internal entries remain outstanding
Set statement ending date before matching; only bank ledger entries up to the statement end date are included
Avoid direct G/L posting to accounts in a bank account posting group because it breaks the bank ledger-to-G/L link
Undo can reopen a posted reconciliation; check statement sequence and subsequent balances
